system.site_name: The name shown in the app header.
system.timezone: Used for heat pump scheduling, price windows and displayed times. Requires a restart.
system.latitude: The home's exact location - drives the weather forecast and the sun position used to estimate solar output. Different from "Location name" under Weather, which is just a display label.
system.longitude: Together with latitude, sets the home's exact location for the weather forecast and solar output estimate.

storage.data_path: Where current readings from every source are stored. A relative path is resolved against the install directory.
storage.logs_path: Where the application's runtime logs are written.
storage.history_path: Where time-series records are stored for charts and analysis.
storage.archive_path: Where older history is moved once it passes the age below. Leave empty to disable archiving.
storage.archive_after_days: How many days of history to keep before archiving.
storage.compress_archive: Archived files are stored compressed to save disk space.
storage.archive_check_hours: How often to check whether anything needs archiving.

logging.level: How much detail is written to the log. DEBUG is most detailed, ERROR logs only failures.
logging.max_bytes: The log file rotates once it reaches this size.
logging.backups: How many rotated log files to keep.

polling.goodwe_seconds: How often current power and battery status are read from the GoodWe inverter.
polling.tng_seconds: How often the heat pump's status is checked. Unrelated to the minimum gap between writes - see the Heat pump section.
polling.shelly_seconds: How often readings are pulled from Shelly devices.
polling.weather_minutes: How often the weather forecast is refreshed.
polling.ote_minutes: How often new electricity prices are checked. A published day's price never changes, so frequent polling isn't needed.

goodwe.enabled: Read data from the GoodWe inverter.
goodwe.host: IP address or hostname of the GoodWe inverter on the local network.
goodwe.family: GoodWe inverter model family - affects how data is read.
goodwe.timeout: How long to wait for the inverter to respond before giving up.
goodwe.retries: How many times to retry a failed read before reporting an error.
goodwe.grid_positive_is_import: The sign convention for grid flow differs by installation - this sets how it's interpreted.
goodwe.battery_positive_is_charge: The sign convention for battery flow differs by installation - this sets how it's interpreted.

tng.enabled: Read the TNG heat pump's status.
tng.connect_file: Path to the file holding the TNG login credentials. Secrets are never stored in the config or in git.
tng.request_timeout_seconds: How long to wait for the TNG server to respond.
tng.minimum_change_interval_seconds: Heat pump protection - the system won't allow two setting writes closer together than this. Do not lower without understanding the consequences.
tng.telemetry_bootstrap_seconds: How far back to backfill telemetry on first start, before local history exists.
tng.telemetry_overlap_seconds: A small safety overlap when resuming from the last fetched sample, so nothing is missed.
tng.write_enabled: Without this, the system only logs what it would send but never actually writes anything.

heating.enabled: Enables automatic heating water temperature control from the schedule.
heating.default_temperature: Used outside the schedule's time windows.

boiler.enabled: Enables automatic hot water temperature control from the schedule.
boiler.default_temperature: Used outside the schedule's time windows.

thermostat.enabled: Enables automatic room thermostat control from the schedule.
thermostat.default_temperature: Used outside the schedule's time windows.

ote.enabled: Fetch day-ahead electricity prices from OTE.
ote.eur_czk_rate: Used only when the current rate can't be fetched from the Czech National Bank.
ote.fetch_rate_from_cnb: Turning this off always uses the fallback rate above.
ote.distribution_czk_kwh: Added to the spot price when computing the final price.
ote.fees_czk_kwh: Additional fees added to the final price, e.g. system services.
ote.vat_rate: E.g. 0.21 for 21%. Applied when computing the final price.
ote.export_price_czk_kwh: The price paid for exported surplus electricity.

weather.forecast_days: How many days ahead the forecast covers.
weather.location_name: Just a display label shown in the app, e.g. "Ostrava, CZ". The forecast itself is computed from the GPS coordinates under General.

shelly.enabled: Read data from Shelly devices on the local network.
shelly.request_timeout_seconds: How long to wait for a single Shelly device to respond.

controller.enabled: Enables automatic decision-making and optimization. Without it, the system only observes and recommends.
controller.max_data_age_seconds: If key data is older than this, optimization stops (safe mode) instead of guessing a value.
controller.decision_interval_seconds: How often the controller evaluates whether any action is needed.

comfort.room_min_c: Below this, comfort takes priority over savings.
comfort.room_max_c: Above this, the system won't keep heating even at a cheap price.
comfort.dhw_min_c: Below this, hot water heating takes priority over savings.
comfort.dhw_max_c: The upper limit hot water is preheated to, even on a cheap price or solar surplus.
comfort.max_preheat_k: How many degrees above the target the system may preheat to on a cheap price or solar surplus.
comfort.quiet_hours_from: From this time, noisier actions (e.g. the boiler) are avoided.
comfort.quiet_hours_to: The quiet-hours restriction lasts until this time.

optimization.aggressiveness: How aggressively the system optimizes for savings at the expense of comfort margin.
optimization.pv_surplus_kw: The surplus above consumption from which it's considered usable for preheating or charging.
optimization.battery_soc_min_pct: Below this level, the battery isn't used for anything but backing up the house.
optimization.cheap_price_percentile: Prices in this cheapest share of the day count as cheap - e.g. 0.25 means the cheapest quarter.
optimization.expensive_price_percentile: Prices in this most expensive share of the day count as expensive.

prediction.enabled: Learns consumption and production from history for the forecast page.
prediction.pv_peak_kwp: Installed peak solar capacity - used to estimate production.
prediction.learning_days: How many recent days of history the typical consumption/production pattern is learned from.
prediction.battery_capacity_kwh: Total home battery capacity - used to estimate state of charge in the forecast.

web.host: Which network address the web interface listens on. 0.0.0.0 means all of them.
web.password: Password for the web interface. Originally set via .env, changed here.

ui.animations: Amount of motion and transitions in the interface.
ui.theme: Light, dark, or follow the system setting.
ui.currency: The currency prices are displayed in.
ui.brand_accent: The interface's accent color (hex code, e.g. #4fb3ff).
